national_day.pick: On which date does {label} celebrate its national day?
national_day.match: Match each country to the date of its national day.

rows.label: United States
rows.description: country located primarily in North America
rows.hook: is home to Hollywood, Silicon Valley and a famous statue of a torch-bearing lady in New York Harbor

rows.label: China
rows.hook: is the world's most populous country after India and home to a famous wall and giant pandas

rows.label: Canada
rows.hook: is famous for maple syrup, hockey, Niagara Falls and a maple leaf on its flag

rows.label: Germany
rows.hook: is known for Oktoberfest, autobahns with no general speed limit, and a once-divided capital

rows.label: Australia
rows.hook: is a continent-sized nation known for kangaroos, koalas and a giant red rock called Uluru

rows.label: Japan
rows.hook: is known for sushi, bullet trains, cherry blossoms and a snow-capped volcano called Fuji

rows.label: Singapore
rows.description: sovereign island country and city-state in maritime Southeast Asia
rows.hook: is a tiny, spotless city-state at the tip of a peninsula, famous for its Merlion mascot and bayfront gardens

rows.label: Brazil
rows.hook: is the land of Carnival, the Amazon rainforest and a giant Christ statue overlooking Rio

rows.label: France
rows.description: country in Western Europe and other continents (through its overseas territories in America, Africa and Oceania)
rows.hook: is known for the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, croissants and fine wine

rows.label: Philippines
rows.hook: is an island nation of more than seven thousand islands, known for its warm-weather beaches and karaoke

rows.label: Saudi Arabia
rows.hook: is a desert kingdom with a vast oil industry, home to the holy cities of Mecca and Medina

rows.label: Mexico
rows.hook: is known for tacos, mariachi, Day of the Dead and the ancient pyramids of the Aztecs and Maya

rows.label: Indonesia
rows.description: island country in Southeast Asia and Oceania
rows.hook: is a sprawling island nation that is home to Bali, Komodo dragons and many active volcanoes

rows.label: United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is a desert federation of seven sheikhdoms, home to the world's tallest building and glitzy Dubai

rows.label: Spain
rows.description: country in southwestern Europe with territories in Africa
rows.hook: is known for flamenco, bullfighting, paella and running with bulls through narrow streets

rows.label: Pakistan
rows.hook: is a South Asian nation that borders India and is home to the second-highest mountain on Earth, K2

rows.label: Italy
rows.hook: is shaped like a boot and known for pizza, pasta, the Colosseum and the leaning tower of Pisa

rows.label: Netherlands
rows.description: one of the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands; with territories in the Caribbean
rows.hook: is a low-lying land of windmills, tulips, canals and bicycles

rows.label: New Zealand
rows.description: island country in the southwest Pacific Ocean
rows.hook: stood in for Middle-earth in a famous fantasy film trilogy and is home to flightless kiwi birds

rows.label: Portugal
rows.hook: is a westernmost mainland European nation known for port wine, custard tarts and famous explorers

rows.label: Malaysia
rows.hook: is a tropical nation known for the Petronas Twin Towers in its capital Kuala Lumpur

rows.label: Poland
rows.hook: is known for pierogi, being the homeland of Marie Curie and Chopin, and a capital rebuilt after wartime ruin

rows.label: Myanmar
rows.hook: is a Southeast Asian nation of golden pagodas, once known to the world by the name Burma

rows.label: Argentina
rows.hook: is the home of tango, big steaks, and a football legend named Diego Maradona

rows.label: Vietnam
rows.hook: is a long, S-shaped Southeast Asian nation famous for pho, conical hats and Ha Long Bay

rows.label: Norway
rows.hook: is a Scandinavian land of deep fjords, the northern lights and Viking ancestors

rows.label: Ukraine
rows.hook: is a big Eastern European nation of wheat fields, with a capital called Kyiv and the Chernobyl site

rows.label: Sri Lanka
rows.hook: is a teardrop-shaped island off the southern tip of India, famous for its tea

rows.label: Bangladesh
rows.hook: is a densely populated delta nation known for the Bengal tiger and the vast Ganges river system

rows.label: Monaco
rows.hook: is a tiny seaside principality famous for its casino, a glamorous Grand Prix and a royal family

rows.label: Albania
rows.hook: is a small Balkan nation on the Adriatic coast, famous for its thousands of concrete bunkers

rows.label: Egypt
rows.description: country in Northeast Africa and Southwest Asia
rows.hook: is the land of the pharaohs, the Sphinx, the Great Pyramids and the River Nile

rows.label: Nigeria
rows.hook: is the most populous nation in Africa, known for its booming film industry nicknamed Nollywood

rows.label: Iceland
rows.description: Nordic island country in the North Atlantic Ocean
rows.hook: is a volcanic island nation of geysers, glaciers and hot springs, with a famous Blue Lagoon

rows.label: Montenegro
rows.hook: is a small Balkan country whose name means black mountain

rows.label: Belgium
rows.hook: is known for chocolate, waffles, fries and hosting the headquarters of the European Union

rows.label: Romania
rows.hook: is a Carpathian land known for Transylvania and the legend of Dracula

rows.label: Finland
rows.hook: is a land of a thousand lakes, saunas, and the home of Santa Claus according to many

rows.label: Algeria
rows.hook: is the largest country in Africa by area, with much of its land covered by the Sahara

rows.label: Luxembourg
rows.hook: is one of Europe's smallest countries and one of the world's wealthiest, known for banking

rows.label: Oman
rows.hook: is a sultanate on the Arabian Peninsula, known for frankincense and its Grand Mosque in Muscat

rows.label: Lebanon
rows.hook: is a Mediterranean country known for its cedar tree emblem and its capital Beirut

rows.label: Estonia
rows.hook: is a Baltic nation with a medieval old town in Tallinn and the birthplace of Skype

rows.label: Hungary
rows.hook: is a landlocked nation split by the Danube into Buda and Pest, famous for goulash and paprika

rows.label: Jordan
rows.hook: is a desert kingdom famous for the rose-red rock city of Petra and the buoyant Dead Sea

rows.label: Chile
rows.description: country in South America and Oceania, with a claim in Antarctica
rows.hook: is a long, thin land along the Andes, known for the Atacama Desert and Easter Island's stone heads

rows.label: Ghana
rows.hook: was the first sub-Saharan African country to gain independence from colonial rule, famed for cocoa

rows.label: Bahrain
rows.hook: is a small island kingdom in the Gulf once famous for its pearl diving

rows.label: Qatar
rows.hook: is a small, wealthy Gulf nation that hosted football's World Cup in the winter

rows.label: Kenya
rows.hook: is known for safaris, the Maasai Mara migration and champion long-distance runners

rows.label: Cameroon
rows.hook: is nicknamed Africa in miniature for its mix of coast, rainforest, mountains and savanna
